title: (g) Aamal & Dua of Umme Dawood
data:
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
BISMILLAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
صَدَقَ اللّٰهُ الْعَظِيْمُ الَّذِيْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْاِكْرَامِ
SADAQALLAAHUL A'ZEEMUL LAZEE LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUWAL HAYYUL QAYYOOMU DHUL JALAALI WAL IKRAAM
Allah, the Supreme, has spoken the truth; there is no god save Him, the Ever-living, the Self-subsisting, the Lord of Majesty and Generosity.
الرَّحْمٰنُ الرَّحِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهٖ شَيْءٌ وَّ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ الْبَصِيْرُ الْخَبِيْرُ
AR-RAHMAANUR RAHEEMUL HALEEMUL KAREEMUL LAZEE LAYSA KA-MITHLIHEE SHAY'UW WA HUWAS SAMEE'UL A'LEEMUL BASEERUL KHABEER
The All-beneficent, the All-merciful, the Clement, the Generous, like Whom there is nothing, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing, the All-seeing, the All-aware.
شَهِدَ اللّٰهُ اَنَّهٗ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ وَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَ اُولُوا الْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
SHAHIDALLAAHU ANNAHOO LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUWA WAL MALAAA'IKATU WA OOLUL I'LMI QAAA'IMAM BIL-QISTI LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUWAL A'ZEEZUL HAKEEM
Allah bears witness that there is no god save Him, and so do the angels and those endowed with knowledge, maintaining justice; there is no god save Him, the Mighty, the Wise.
merits: Dua Ummi Dawud is one of the most celebrated supplications of the 15th of Rajab, taught by Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) to Umm Dawud for the release of her son Dawud from captivity in Iraq.
